results.title: 63 Photos Of Expensive Mistakes And Accidents You Can Be Glad Are Not Your Problem
results.description: Luck can be wildly unpredictable. One moment, everything seems to be going our way, and the next, we are left wondering what we did to deserve such a rough turn. These painfully expensive fails were shared online by people who ended up on the wrong side of fortune and had the photos to prove it. They are a painful reminder that sometimes, no matter how careful we are, some situations are simply out of our control.

results.title: 'Ebenezer': Johnny Depp transforms into Scrooge in first trailer from 'A Christmas Carol' adaptation; surprises fans at Comic-Con
results.description: Johnny Depp surprised fans at San Diego Comic-Con portraying Ebenezer Scrooge. Paramount Pictures unveiled the first trailer for the horror-fantasy film 'Ebenezer'. The movie is an adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic novella, promising a darker interpretation. The film stars Ian McKellen, Andrea Riseborough, and Rupert Grint in supporting roles. 'Ebenezer' is scheduled for a November 13 theatrical release date.
